$description: NEXUS 0.2: the tokens that every theme shares, drafted in stage 09 on 2026-11-03 from phase 1's hub page, kept for direction A, Hub pages, chosen that day, and frozen for NEXUS 0.2 at the stage's second checkpoint the same day. Colours and shadows are in theme/light.tokens.json and theme/dark.tokens.json, which tokens.resolver.json chooses between.

sans.$description: Phase 1's stack: the device's own fonts, Korean included, since NEXUS loads no font from elsewhere (REQ-147)

mono.$description: IDs, commits and stage source text

caption.$description: Tags, counts in marks, trace IDs under errors: 12 px

title.$description: Panel and section headings: 18.4 px, as phase 1's cards

page.$description: A page's one heading: 22.4 px, as phase 1's title

body.$description: Phase 1's body; Korean body text needs 1.5 or more

tight.$description: Marks and tags of one line

lg.$description: The side gutter at 320 pixels, as phase 1

sm.$description: Trace ID chips and level tags

sheet.$description: The top corners of a bottom sheet

strong.$description: Focus rings, the halo of a mark and the outline of an accepted item

target.$description: The least height and width of anything a finger selects, a mark's too

pin.$description: A corner pin as drawn; its target is size.target

cluster.$description: Marks merged while the whole picture shows

box.$description: The least height of a comment, reply or words box

source.$description: The most height of a proposal's stage source text; more scrolls inside its own box

panel.$description: The side panel from 1,024 pixels (choice 3 of stage 08)

column.$description: The stage overview's column, as phase 1's page

stage.$description: The least height and width of a stage in the hub's strip of 13, as phase 1

disabled.$description: A control that waits or does nothing now, such as Reply without text or Whole picture while it shows

picture-height.$description: The picture's frame at 320 pixels: this share of the screen's height

sheet-height.$description: A bottom sheet at most this share of the screen's height

side-panel.$description: From this width the panels open beside the picture

fast.$description: Colour changes of controls, as phase 1

sheet.$description: A sheet or a side panel opening; reduced motion fades instead

exit.$description: Accelerating, only for what leaves the screen
